justification: Strict top-k recall may not fall. The v0.11 program keeps driving this toward 100%. v0.12 wave 7: the first seal attempt briefly carried two exact rows memorising held-out types; the memorised ceiling caught it, the rows were reverted, and this ratchet value is reduced to the honest post-revert actual.

Regression guard only. Raw top-1 requires exactly one analysis, so genuine syncretism caps it; it is never an objective and may only fall with a stated syncretism justification. v0.12 wave 7: the first seal attempt briefly carried two exact rows memorising held-out types; the memorised ceiling caught it, the rows were reverted, and this ratchet value is reduced to the honest post-revert actual. v0.12 wave 8 (-327): the new noun paradigms model genuine case syncretism (пасхи is genitive singular and nominative plural; the жена and законъ plural scopes add readings to previously single-reading tokens), so exactly-one-analysis tokens fell while lemma-unique coverage rose.

Tokens resolving to exactly one lexical identity. Unlike top-1 this is not capped by syncretism, so a fall means real identity ambiguity was introduced. v0.12 wave 7: the first seal attempt briefly carried two exact rows memorising held-out types; the memorised ceiling caught it, the rows were reverted, and this ratchet value is reduced to the honest post-revert actual.

Tokens whose readings span more than one lexeme. Genuine homonymy is real and stays, but a duplicated identity raises this while making the analyzer worse, and one shipped on this branch before the ceiling existed. New homonymy now needs a stated justification. v0.12 wave 1 (+18): the Alypy §73 reflexive derivation inherits its host's readings, so a host that already spans two lexemes yields a two-lexeme reflexive reading; no identity was added. v0.12 wave 5 (+120): the productive послꙋшати admission was merged onto the reviewed identity wikt-bbe1760d7910, but the immutable v0.6 past-classification record pins one aorist print to the duplicate v06-72858c58897d9d01, so послꙋ́ша keeps two identities until the identity-merge wave.
